about: The Launch bench: one ranked 'do this first' list for the Herd's product launch (raven575 lost their job 2026-11-19; goal: launch vCGE and earn). Steps 1-9 are raven575's own human steps; 10+ are what teams are doing. Built from HQ-0342 replies, the Launch Board and the app-store plan. Update by editing this file and rerunning the installer; ticks match by id + step number.
title: Do This First
intro: Breathe. One thing at a time, top to bottom. Steps 1 to 9 are yours (most are one tap); everything from 10 down, the teams are already doing.

items.title: 🛡 Set up admin@herdofhelpers.com as the Herd admin login
items.area: 🙋 You · one login for the Herd
items.why: You picked admin@herdofhelpers.com (17:12 UTC 11-19) as the Herd-wide admin login. The vCGE Gmail stays the Play owner; this one does the day-to-day admin and is the public contact.
steps: At your domain host, forward admin@herdofhelpers.com to the inbox you read.
Make a Google account with it: https://accounts.google.com/signup, then 'Use your existing email'.
Play Console, Users and permissions: invite admin@herdofhelpers.com as Admin. Keep the vCGE Gmail as owner.
Switch the public contact email (Play developer page and store listing) to admin@herdofhelpers.com.
Turn on 2-Step Verification on BOTH accounts and print the backup codes. Keep the paper offline, never in the Herd.
Name the Google payments profile and Stripe 'Herd of Helpers'.

items.title: 🟢 Google Play developer account
items.why: Play needs 12 testers for 14 days in a row before vCGE can go on sale. That clock can't start until the account exists, so this is the longest pole. One-time fee is $25 (your money, your yes).
items.where: Play Console sign-up (personal account, your Google sign-in).
steps: Open https://play.google.com/console/signup and make a Personal account (skip if you have one).
Do the ID check it asks for. Tick Pass when the Console opens.

items.title: 👥 Make the Google Group for Play testers
items.why: Testers join this group to get into the closed test. Creative's Facebook post will point here. Aim for about 20 people so 12 stay the full 14 days.
items.where: Google Groups, signed in as you.
steps: Open https://groups.google.com/my-groups and press Create group. Name: vCGE testers.
Who can join: Ask to join. Who can see the group: anyone on the web.
Paste the group's web address in the note box so 🐼 Creative and 🦚 Marketing can share it.

items.title: 💛 Tip jar accounts: Stripe, then Sponsors, then Liberapay
items.why: Tips are the fastest money: no store review. PR #51 is ready to switch the links on the moment each account is live.
steps: Stripe: https://dashboard.stripe.com/register (Individual / sole proprietor). Make a Payment Link 'Tip for vCGE', paste the link in the tip-jar thread.
GitHub Sponsors: https://github.com/sponsors/accounts (GitHub reviews it in a few days).
Liberapay: https://liberapay.com/sign-up, connect Stripe only, paste your username in the tip-jar thread.

items.title: 🔑 Pick how the Play upload key signs
items.why: Protected (recommended): CI signs each build only after you click Approve. Offline: you sign by hand on your PC. The key backup goes in Vaultwarden once it's built.
steps: Tap Answer here and pick Protected or Offline on the card in the app-store thread.

decision.where: thread 🐢 Get vCGE onto app stores
decision.label: Answer here

items.title: 🧾 Free EIN (10 minutes)
items.why: Keeps your Social Security number off store, Stripe and tax forms. Free from the IRS; never pay a site for it.
steps: Open https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/get-an-employer-identification-number and apply online (sole proprietor).
Save the letter it gives you to your private files. Do not paste the number anywhere in the Herd.

items.title: 🪟 Reserve the name vCGE in Microsoft Partner Center
items.why: Locks the name and gives the identity values the Windows package needs (PR #53 holds test values until then).
steps: Open https://partner.microsoft.com/dashboard/apps-and-games/overview, then New product, MSIX or PWA app, type vCGE, Reserve.
Copy the Product identity values (Name, Publisher CN=, Store ID 9N...) into the app-store thread. These are safe to share.

items.title: ✅ Two quick answers for teams
items.why: 🦏 Deadbolt (Vault) needs a list of which launch accounts exist to start the 2FA check. 🐿 History needs a go for a Nextcloud session to write the Herd story.
steps: Tell 🦏 Deadbolt (Team Vault): the names of the accounts you've made (no passwords).
Say 'go' in 🐿 History's mail thread for their Nextcloud session.

items.title: 📞 Optional: ask the state unemployment office one question
items.area: 🙋 You · when you have a minute
items.why: Contract work that was promised to become a job may count as misclassification, which can change what you're owed. Worth one call; nothing depends on it.
steps: Call the state unemployment office (the number is in the Rank Herd priorities thread) and ask if your contract work can count as misclassification.

items.title: 🐢 Store builds: Play bundle + Windows package (PR #53)
items.why: Builds the files both stores take, with the privacy policy and listing text.

steps.text: Get PR #53 CI green 11/11, then ready for review.
Plug in the Play key after your pick (step 5) and the Microsoft identity after step 7.

items.title: 🦚 Tester sign-up note + listing review
items.why: A friendly note to recruit about 20 real testers (no tester farms) and a review of the store text.

steps.text: Write the 14-day tester note and post it with the Google Group link.

items.title: 🐼 Store art + Facebook tester post
items.why: Play icon 512, feature graphic 1024x500, Microsoft logo set, screenshots from made-up cards.

steps.text: Make the store art into vcge-drop/.
Post the tester call on Facebook, pointing at the Google Group.

items.title: 🦏 Keys, 2FA check, secret sweep
items.why: Every account gets 2FA and paper recovery codes; nothing secret goes public.

steps.text: Sheriff check on each account you list (step 8).
Read-only secret sweep of repo, listing, screenshots and tester note before anything goes public.

items.title: 🐹 Price, fees and tax-form names
items.why: $0.99 nets about $0.84 a sale. Bankers check store shares and payout forms.

steps.text: Send the fee and tax-form summary on HQ-0342.

items.title: 🐿 Herd story + Meet the Herd
items.why: Story for the tip jar and About pages; one line per character for store pages.

items.title: 📬 Waiting on top-3 lists
items.why: 2 of 10 teams have answered HQ-0342 (Vault, History). Left: Creative, Marketing, 9to5, Auto-Fixer, Bankers, HomeLab, eMail, Never Forget. Their items join this list as they answer.
